title: Coming to Memphis at 12-13; jug bands and big bands on Beale Street
summary: Lewis was raised in Memphis; plenty of string band, jug band and larger band music then. He never played in the traveling big bands.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Oh. And did you grow up out there in Greenwood or?
How old were you when you came to Memphis?
Oh, I guess I was about 12 or 13 years old.
And was there any music in Memphis when you got here?

Well, plenty of music. What kind of music? Well, there's string band, guitar music, harmonious like it always is. But more of it then than it is now. It's all just about going away now. Mm-hmm. There used to be plenty of music here. Yeah. Cause when I was playing in Memphis Jug Band, it was all up and down Beale Street near YL.
So they had jug bands when you first got here? Or did you see any jugs or not?
Jug bands. Oh, yeah? Oh, yeah. Jug bands been in for many years. Mm-hmm.
What about cornets? Well, there was a larger band than what we had. Mm-hmm.
Do you remember any of the big bands?

Well, no, I don't. I never did play in big bands like that. Cause they mostly done more traveling than we did. We just was homeless boys around here, certain they didn't go to different places, different parties, different things like that.
